entry.title: Joining up AI across recruitment, retention and alumni relations can close graduation gaps, if it is governed well
entry.summary:
A rubutunsa a cikin University World News, darektan aikin IREX, Cameron Mirza, ya ce ya kamata jami'o'i su ɗauki shigar da ɗalibai, riƙe su, da alaƙa da tsofaffin ɗalibai a matsayin wani zagaye guda ɗaya da aka haɗa kuma AI ke taimakawa, maimakon tsarurruka daban daban masu bayanai daban daban. Ya kawo misalin shirin chatbot da nazarin hasashe na Georgia State University, wanda ake yabawa da rage "summer melt" da kusan kashi 21, da kuma taimaka wa ɗalibai Bakaken fata, 'yan Hispanic, na farkon iyali, da masu ƙarancin kuɗin shiga su kammala karatu a adadin da ya yi daidai ko ya zarce na sauran ɗalibai, yana mai gargaɗi cewa samfuran da aka horar da su a kan tsoffin bayanai na iya kuma ƙara tabbatar da rashin adalci da ake son gyarawa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Dangane da ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI da nazarin hasashe domin nasarar ɗalibai, wannan rubutu tunatarwa ce mai amfani cewa kayan aikin gargaɗi da wuri da riƙe ɗalibai suna rufe gibin rashin daidaito ne kawai idan aka haɗa su da kulawar ɗan'adam da gwajin son zuciya, wannan shi ne tambayar gudanarwa da Wits AHEAD take yi wa duk wani kayan aiki na nazari da take ba da shawarar amfani da shi.

University World News · Established higher education press (commentary by a sector practitioner)

entry.title: Wits researchers argue Africa must set its own AI research agenda, not just apply others' tools
entry.summary:
Masana kimiyyar kwamfuta biyu na University of the Witwatersrand, Benjamin Rosman da Steve James, wadanda ke jagorantar Robotics, Autonomous Intelligence and Learning (RAIL) Lab tare, sun ce ya kamata Afirka ta jagoranci bincike kan AI maimakon amfani da kayan aikin da aka kera a wani wuri dabam. Sun yi nuni da Deep Learning Indaba, wadda yanzu ita ce babbar makarantar bazara ta AI mafi girma a duniya, wadda ta jawo hankalin mahalarta 1,300 a taron bara da aka yi a Kigali, kuma take gudanar da shirinta na IndabaX a kasashe 48 daga cikin 54 na Afirka a wannan shekarar, tare da sabuwar cibiyar Wits ta Machine Intelligence and Neural Discovery (MIND) Institute, wadda ta haɗa ƙwararru kusan 65 daga fannonin kimiyyar kwamfuta, ilimin kwakwalwa, ilimin halayyar ɗan'adam da manufofi.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Dangane da ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai ɗaukar nauyi, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, gargaɗin da ke cewa kada Afirka ta zama kawai "wurin da wasu mutane ke yin bincike" yana da alaƙa kai tsaye da manufar Wits AHEAD ta kafa ƙwarewar da Afirkawa ke jagoranta wajen tsara tambayoyin bincike na AI, ba kawai amfani da kayan aikin AI da aka kera a wani wuri dabam ba.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: Study of students in China, Japan and Mongolia finds access to generative AI does not guarantee it is useful for learning
entry.summary:
Wata takarda bincike da ta yi nazari a kan ɗaliban digiri na farko 42 a jami'a guda a kowanne daga cikin China, Japan da Mongolia ta gano cewa yadda ɗalibai ke samun AI mai samar da abun ciki, ko ta hanyar kai tsaye, ta dandamalin duniya, ko ta sauya harshe, ke tantance ko tana da amfani a gare su da gaske, ba kawai ko za su iya samun ta ba. Misali, ɗaliban Mongolia sun saba sauyawa zuwa Turanci a duk sa'ad da amsoshin harshen Mongolian suka gaza, yayin da dukkan ƙungiyoyi ukun suka yi la'akari da daidaito, sirri, dogaro, da tasirin kayan aikin a kan tunaninsu mai zurfi. Marubutan, Ming Li, Qin Xie, Ariunaa Enkhtur, Lilan Chen da Fei Cheng, sun kammala cewa samun fasaha kaɗai ba ya tabbatar da amfani daidai a fannin ilimi a cikin saitunan harshe da fasaha daban daban.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Dangane da ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, binciken da ya nuna cewa harshe da yanayin fasaha na gida, ba haɗin kai kaɗai ba, ke tantance ko AI mai samar da abun ciki tana taimaka wa ɗalibai koyo da gaske, gargaɗi ne da Wits AHEAD take amfani da shi daidai wa daida ga kayan aikin AI masu rinjayen Turanci da ake amfani da su a jami'o'i masu harsuna da yawa na Kudancin Afirka.

arXiv (working paper) · Working paper (preprint, not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: South African minister tells universities to move from AI debate to decisions on teaching and research
entry.summary:
A jawabinsa a Taron Manyan Makarantu na Jami'o'in Afirka ta Kudu karo na hudu a ranar 7 ga Oktoba, 2026, Ministan Manyan Makarantu da Horarwa, Buti Manamela, ya shaida wa jami'o'i cewa AI yana ƙara muhimmancin aikinsu na asali, wato koyar da tunani mai zurfi da ɗaukar nauyin sahihancin ilimi, maimakon rage shi, domin tsarin AI na iya fitar da bayanai masu ƙarfin gwiwa ba tare da tabbatar da gaskiyarsu ba. Ya ce tambayar gaskiya ta wuce ko ɗalibai suna amfani da AI wajen ayyukansu, ta kai ga wanda ke ƙirƙirar fasahar, harsuna da gogewar wane ne take wakilta, wanda ke sarrafa kayan aikinta, da wanda ke amfana da ita. Ya kuma yi kira ga fannonin ɗan'adam da ilimin zamantakewa su yi aiki tare da injiniyanci da kimiyyar halitta kan son zuciya, iko da tasirin aiki da ke tattare da fasahar.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Dangane da ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, ministan gwamnati yana kafa manufa bayyananniya kan koyarwa, tantancewa da ƙarfin bincike maimakon muhawara ta gaba ɗaya, yana ba jami'o'in Afirka ta Kudu wata hujja ta fili don aiwatarwa.

South African Government News Agency (SAnews) · National government news agency

entry.title: UNESCO study finds 87% of Latin American and Caribbean universities already use AI, but only 26% have a formal strategy
entry.summary:
Wata takarda bincike ta UNESCO IESALC tare da UNU-IAS, wadda ta yi nazari a kan cibiyoyin manyan makarantu 200 a cikin ƙasashe 19 na Latin Amurka da Caribbean tsakanin Agusta zuwa Oktoba na 2025, ta gano cewa kashi 87 cikin ɗari na amfani da AI a kalla a wani fanni guda, inda koyarwa da koyo (kashi 74) da bincike (kashi 57) suka jagoranta, amma kashi 26 ne kawai suke da manufar AI ta hukuma, kuma kashi 55 ba su da wata kasafin kuɗi na AI ko kaɗan. Yaɗuwa da gudanarwa duk suna bin irin cibiyar sosai: kashi 84 na jami'o'in masu zaman kansu marasa riba suna amfani da AI idan aka kwatanta da kashi 68 na jami'o'in gwamnati, kuma kashi 17 na jami'o'in gwamnati sun ba da rahoton rashin horar da ma'aikata ko kaɗan, idan aka kwatanta da kashi 3 na jami'o'in masu zaman kansu marasa riba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Dangane da ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai ɗaukar nauyi, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, binciken da ya nuna cewa amfani da AI ya yaɗu sosai yayin da gudanarwar hukuma ta yi nisa a baya, kuma ba daidai ba tsakanin cibiyoyin gwamnati da na masu zaman kansu, yana nuna gibin gudanarwa da Wits AHEAD take gani a faɗin Kudancin Duniya.

UNESCO IESALC and UNU-IAS, reported by Times Higher Education · Established higher education press, reporting a UNESCO/UNU-IAS working paper

entry.title: UTeach survey finds STEM teacher-training staff cautiously optimistic about AI but wary of integrity and bias risks
entry.summary:
Wani bincike da ya ƙunshi ma'aikata 57 na koyarwa, gudanarwa da sauran ma'aikata daga shirye-shirye 31 na horar da malaman STEM na sakandare a kwalejoji da jami'o'i 54 na Amurka, ya gano cewa kashi 77 cikin ɗari sun yarda cewa AI na da yuwuwar yin tasiri mai kyau a kan aikinsu, yayin da kashi 61 cikin ɗari suka bayyana kansu a matsayin masu amfani da AI tun da wuri. Kashi 63 cikin ɗari na ci gaba da damuwa kan ƙalubale, musamman gaskiyar ilimi (kashi 42) da son zuciya na ɗa'a (kashi 21), yayin da kashi 70 cikin ɗari suka nuna buƙatar horo mai zurfi; kashi 79 cikin ɗari na malaman suna riga suna haɗa AI a cikin karatunsu, galibi don tsara darussa da ƙirƙirar tantancewa, maimakon bincike mai yawan bayanai a fannin STEM.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Dangane da ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI da nazarin bayanai a fannin STEM da horar da malamai, gibin da ke tsakanin malaman da ke gwada AI tun yanzu da tsarin bincike na bai ɗaya da suke cewa ba su da shi, shi ne irin jagoran da shirye-shiryen horar da malamai a Kudancin Duniya za su buƙaci su ma.

The UTeach Institute, The University of Texas at Austin · University research institute report

entry.title: Systematic review finds no existing framework yet addresses the ethical and instructional challenges of AI in STEM teaching
entry.summary:
Wani bincike mai tsari da masu bincike daga Wentworth Institute of Technology da University of New Haven suka gudanar ya duba tsare-tsaren koyarwa da aka kafa kamar TPACK, SAMR, ADDIE da Universal Design for Learning, dangane da samfuran ilimin AI da ƙa'idojin AI mai ɗaukar nauyi, domin ganin yadda suke tallafa wa malaman STEM wajen koyarwa. Binciken ya gano cewa babu ko ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan tsare-tsaren da ya magance ƙalubalen sana'a, ɗa'a da koyarwa na amfani da AI a fannin STEM, kuma cewa amfani da kayan aikin AI yana tafiya gaba da jagorar koyarwa mai tsari, abin da ke haifar da ayyuka da kayan aiki ke tuƙa maimakon tsarin da ke tuƙa su.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Dangane da ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI da nazarin bayanai a fannin STEM da horar da malamai, binciken da ya nuna cewa babu tsarin koyarwa da ya magance ƙalubalen ɗa'a da koyarwa na AI yana ƙarfafa hujjar aikin ƙungiyar kan haɗa AI mai ɗaukar nauyi musamman a fannin STEM.

American Society for Engineering Education (ASEE), North East Section Conference · Peer-reviewed conference paper

entry.title: More universities end Turnitin contracts as concerns mount
entry.summary:
Jaridar Times Higher Education ta ba da rahoton cewa Jami'ar Newcastle da Jami'ar Westminster sun haɗu da Jami'ar Southampton wajen soke yarjejeniyoyinsu da kamfanin gano satar ilimi, Turnitin, bayan kamfanin ya gabatar da canje-canjen lasisi da za su iya ba da damar yin amfani da aikin ɗalibai don horar da kayan aikin AI. Newcastle ta ambaci wannan sharaɗin bayanai kai tsaye; Westminster ta ce na'urar binciken satar ilimi ta Turnitin 'bata da tasiri sosai' wajen gano rubutun da AI ta rubuta, kuma na'urar gano AI tasu na ɗauke da 'haɗarin da aka sani na kuskuren tantancewa'. Southampton kaɗai ta biya Turnitin fam 87,621 a shekara guda, daga cikin ɗalibai sama da 17,000 na digiri na farko da 8,000 na gaba da digiri.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai alhaki, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, wannan takaddama ta nuna jami'o'i suna farawa auna gudanarwar bayanai da ainihin inganci na kayan aikin gano AI da tsadar su, maimakon ɗaukar yarjejeniyar gano satar ilimi a matsayin wajibi da ba za a canza shi ba.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: Prepare students for post-graduation AI judgement challenges
entry.summary:
Jaridar University World News ta ce martanin manyan makarantu ga AI mai samar da abun ciki yana tsayawa da wuri, wato a lokacin kammala karatu, alhali ainihin jarrabawar hukuncin sana'a yakan zo bayan haka. Ta ambaci gwajin filin da aka yi rajista a gaba a shekarar 2026 a mujallar Organization Science, inda mashawarta 758 na Boston Consulting Group suka gudanar da ayyuka na gaskiya tare da ko ba tare da mataimaki na AI mai samar da abun ciki ba. A galibin ayyukan, ƙungiyar da ta yi amfani da AI ta yi aiki da sauri kuma a matakin da ya fi girma, amma a wani tsarin ayyuka guda da ya fita kaɗan daga iyawar na'urar, kashi 70.6 cikin ɗari kawai na mashawarta da suka yi amfani da AI ne suka samu amsa daidai, idan aka kwatanta da kashi 84.5 cikin ɗari na waɗanda suka yi aiki ba tare da taimako ba, kuma masu tantancewa da ba su san amsar ba sun ɗauki shawarwarin da ba daidai ba na AI a matsayin masu ƙarfin gaskatawa kamar su na daidai.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI, ƙwarewar ɗaliban da suka kammala karatu, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, ganowar cewa aikin AI mai kuskure amma mai tsaron gaba na iya zama mai ƙarfin gaskatawa kamar aikin daidai, ya nuna cewa hukuncin sana'a, ba ƙwarewar AI kaɗai ba, shi ne ƙwarewar da ɗaliban da suka kammala karatu suke bukata kafin su shiga kasuwar aikin yi.

University World News · Established higher education press, commentary citing a peer-reviewed field experiment

entry.title: UNESCO and Codemao's AI coding drive reaches more African classrooms
entry.summary:
UNESCO da dandalin rubutun lambobin kwamfuta na China, Codemao, sun ce shirin su na hadin gwiwa na koyar wa matasa rubutun lambobin kwamfuta na ci gaba da fadada a Afirka. Mataki na biyu, wanda zai kai har zuwa 2030, ya horar da malamai 200 a Jamhuriyar Congo, Kenya, Namibia da Thailand, kashi 45 cikin dari daga cikinsu mata ne, kuma an baiwa Kenya na'urorin tablet 200 ga makarantun sakandare na junior 20.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI da nazarin bayanai a cikin ilimin STEM da horar da malamai, wannan shiri yana nuna wata hanya ta ginawa malamai iyawar AI da rubutun lambobin kwamfuta a Kudancin Duniya, tare da mayar da hankali kan mata.

Xinhua (New China TV) · Major international news agency, video report

entry.title: PISA 2025 finds AI chatbot use split with student learning outcomes
entry.summary:
Jarabawar PISA 2025 ta OECD, wacce ita ce ta farko da ta duba yadda daliban shekara 15 suke amfani da AI, ta tambayi dalibai sama da 760,000 a kasashe 91. Ta gano cewa dogaro da yawa kan chatbot na AI wajen rubuta aikin gida yana da alaka da maki kasa a kimiyya, yayin da amfani matsakaici kuma da jagora ke nuna sakamako daban kuma mai kyau; makin karatu da lissafi su ma sun fadi sosai a kasashen OECD cikin shekaru goma da suka gabata.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, koyarwa, tantancewa da gaskiyar ilimi, wannan alama ce ta farko ta halayen da daliban za su kawo jami'a, da abin da jami'a za ta bukaci koyarwa da tantancewa.

OECD (via Newsweek) · Intergovernmental body's flagship international assessment, reported by established press

entry.title: Understanding ethical dimensions of AI in higher education: insights from faculty members and students
entry.summary:
Wani bincike da ya yi amfani da hade-haden hanyoyi ya tambayi dalibai 971 da ma'aikatan jami'a 135, sannan ya yi hira da dalibai 23 da malamai 14, kan ɗa'ar AI a manyan makarantu. Kungiyoyin biyu sun amince gaba daya kan yin amfani da AI yadda ya dace, amma ra'ayinsu ya bambanta: malamai sun jaddada ka'idojin ɗa'a amma sun ce jami'o'insu ba su da jagororin tsari, yayin da dalibai suka ga AI yana da amfani ga koyo amma ba su tabbata inda nauyinsu na ɗa'a ya tsaya.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai ɗaukar nauyi, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, shawarwarin binciken, horar da ma'aikata, darussan ɗa'a na musamman, da jagororin jami'a bayyanannu, suna ba da jerin abubuwan aiki ga cibiyoyin da ba su da manufar ɗa'ar AI ta tsari tukuna.

International Journal of Educational Technology in Higher Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: From AI literacy to action: South Africa charts a path forward for teacher education
entry.summary:
Ma'aikatar Ilimi Mai Zurfi da Horo ta Afirka ta Kudu da Commonwealth of Learning sun shirya taron karo-karo na kwanaki biyu kan AI a horar da malamai, a sashen Future Africa na Jami'ar Pretoria. Malamai, masu tsara manufofi, da shugabannin tsarin ilimi sun amince da wata hanyar manufofin kasa mai sauki canzawa kuma ta tushen ka'idoji, kuma sun kafa kungiyar aiki ta kasa, inda sakamakon zai taimaka wajen bitar da ake yi na bukatun mafi karanci na cancantar horar da malamai, wadda mahalarta suka bayyana cewa a yanzu bata ambaci komai kan AI.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI da nazari a kimiyyar STEM da horar da malamai, wannan ya nuna tsari bayyananne, karkashin jagorancin gwamnati, wanda yake mayar da ilimin AI zuwa manufar kasa kan cancanta a tsarin horar da malamai na Afirka ta Kudu.

Commonwealth of Learning · Intergovernmental organisation report on a national government workshop

entry.title: Supporting cost-effective AI adoption in education
entry.summary:
Bankin Duniya ya fitar da wata takarda ta bincike, Costing AI Use in Education in Low- and Middle-Income Countries, tare da rubutun blog da ke bayyana yadda ma'aikatun ilimi za su tsara kasafin kudin AI. Ta ba da shawarar farawa da kayan aiki da za su taimaka wa malamai, kamar shirya darasi da bayar da ra'ayi, maimakon fara amfani da su ga dalibai duka a lokaci guda, kuma a kwatanta kudin AI da kudin da ake kashewa yanzu wajen fadada koyarwar gargajiya, da kuma amfani da na'urori da hanyoyin sadarwar waya da ake da su a makarantu. Bankin Duniya ya kiyasta cewa cimma burin ci gaba mai dorewa na ilimi a Kudancin Hamadar Sahara zai bukaci dalar Amurka biliyan 6.4 kowace shekara don malaman firamare da biliyan 38.7 kowace shekara don malaman sakandare nan da shekarar 2030, in ba haka ba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan nazari da bayanai don tsarin ilimi da yanke shawara, wannan rahoto yana baiwa ma'aikatun ilimi da cibiyoyi a Kudancin Duniya wani tsari bayyananne mai kudin da aka kiyasta na yanke shawarar inda kashe kudin AI a ilimi zai fi amfani.

World Bank · Intergovernmental body blog, summarising a World Bank working paper

entry.title: Grappling with "homework scams", US universities shun AI detectors
entry.summary:
Rahoton AFP da eNCA ta ɗauko ya bayyana yadda Yale, Cornell da Jami'ar Wisconsin-Madison ke hana ko kawar da ma'aikatansu daga amfani da software na gano AI a matsayin shaidar zamba, bayan da bincike ya gano cewa waɗannan kayan aiki ba su da aminci kuma suna yawan yi wa marasa laifi zargi, har da waɗanda Ingilishi ba yarensu na asali ba ne. Wata malama ta ilmin halittu a Wisconsin-Madison, wadda ta ɓoye umarni a cikin aiki, ta kama ɗalibai 60 daga cikin 350 da ke amfani da AI ba tare da an gano su ta hanyar bincike na yau da kullum ba, kuma yanzu tana matsawa zuwa jarrabawar baka da muhawarar bidiyo maimakon rubutun kasidu; wani bincike na American Association of Colleges and Universities da Jami'ar Elon ya gano cewa kashi 95 cikin ɗari na malamai suna tsoron dogaro da ɗalibai kan AI fiye da kima.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, musamman tantancewa da gaskiyar ilimi, shi ne Ginshiƙi na 1 na Wits AHEAD, kuma wannan ja da baya daga software na gano AI a jami'o'i masu daraja alama ce kai tsaye kuma mai amfani ga yadda ƴungiyar ya kamata ta ba da shawara kan sake tsara tantancewa maimakon ganowa a matsayin amsar yin zagon ƙasa na AI.

AFP (via eNCA) · Established press (wire service report)

entry.title: Global Employment Trends for Youth 2026: Back to the Future
entry.summary:
Rahoton Kungiyar Kwadago ta Duniya, Global Employment Trends for Youth 2026, ya gano cewa adadin rashin aikin yi na matasa a duniya ya tashi zuwa kashi 12.4 cikin ɗari a shekarar 2025, wanda ya bar kusan matasa miliyan 67 masu shekaru 15 zuwa 24 ba su da aikin yi, yayin da kusan ɗaya cikin matasa biyar, kusan miliyan 257, ba su kasance cikin aikin yi, karatu, ko horo ba. Rahoton ya kiyasta cewa kashi 6.1 cikin ɗari na ayyukan da matasa masu shekaru 15 zuwa 29 ke yi suna cikin babban haɗarin maye gurbinsu da AI, galibi ayyukan ofis da na rubuce-rubuce da suka riga suka ragu ga matasa ma'aikata, kuma ya yi kira ga shugabanci na AI da fasaha mai mayar da hankali ga ɗan'adam, tare da ƙarin tallafi zuwa aikin yi mai daraja.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Samun aikin yi ga waɗanda suka kammala karatu da sauye-sauye masu adalci, wanda ya haɗa da yadda AI take canza ayyukan matakin farko, shi ne Ginshiƙi na 4 na Wits AHEAD, kuma abin da wannan rahoto na gwamnatocin duniya ya gano, cewa ayyukan ofis, wanda sau da yawa shi ne mataki na farko ga waɗanda suka kammala karatu, suna cikin haɗari mafi girma ga AI, ya ba ƴungiyar ma'auni madogara kuma na duniya don aikinta kan AI da samun aikin yi ga waɗanda suka kammala karatu a Kudancin Duniya.

International Labour Organization · Intergovernmental body report

entry.title: Generative AI use and misuse call for assessment reform in higher education
entry.summary:
Wani bincike da masana suka tantance a mujallar Science ya binciki ɗalibai sama da 95,000 a jami'o'i 20 manya na gwamnati na bincike a Amurka, a shekarar karatu ta 2023-24. Ya gano cewa kashi 37 cikin ɗari na ɗalibai suna amfani da AI mai samar da abun ciki aƙalla sau ɗaya a wata don ayyukansu, kuma marubutan sun kiyasta cewa kusan kashi 9 cikin ɗari sun yi amfani da ita don yin zamba, adadin da ya tashi zuwa kashi 26 cikin ɗari a tsakanin masu amfani kullum; amfani da zamba sun bambanta sosai bisa fannin karatu. Marubutan suna kira da a yi gyare-gyaren tantancewa da suka dace da kowane fanni maimakon hani ɗaya tak ko tsarin ganowa na dukan jami'a.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, musamman tantancewa da gaskiyar ilimi, shi ne Ginshiƙi na 1 na Wits AHEAD, kuma abin da wannan babban bincike ya gano, cewa yin zagon ƙasa yana bambanta bisa fanni ba daidai ko'ina ba, ya ba ƙungiyar hujja madogara don tsara gyaren tantancewa na kowane fanni, maimakon gyara ɗaya tak.

Science · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: UCT summit puts AI, inequality and future of universities in spotlight
entry.summary:
Taron Koli na Ilimi na Duniya na Times Higher Education ya buɗe a Jami'ar Cape Town a ranar 30 ga Satumba, 2026, karo na farko da taron ya gudana a Afirka. Shugabannin manyan makarantu, masana da masu tsara manufofi kusan 600 daga ƙasashe sama da 60 ne suka halarta; Mataimakin Shugaban Jami'ar, Farfesa Mosa Moshabela, ya ce makomar jami'ar ba za ta iya zama kawai game da amfani da fasaha ba, yayin da Ministan Manyan Makarantu, Buti Manamela, ya yi kira da AI ta fadada damar samun ilimi, tare da ƙwarewar AI mai zurfi da ingantacciyar damar samun fasaha. Jami'ar Cape Town ta daina dogaro da shirye-shiryen gano AI, maimakon haka ta ƙirƙiri tsarin kanta na yadda ɗalibai da ma'aikata za su yi amfani da AI mai samar da abun ciki.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Samun dama daidai ga AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu shi ne ginshiƙi na farko daga cikin ginshiƙai shida na Wits AHEAD, kuma ministan da ya ambaci ƙwarewar AI, ba shirye-shiryen gano AI ba, a matsayin sharaɗin samun dama daidai, ya zo daidai da yankin da aikin manufofi da koyarwa na ƙungiyar ke mamaye.

TimesLIVE · Established press

entry.title: Global Index on Responsible AI: 2026 Report
entry.summary:
Global Index on Responsible AI ta 2026, wanda Global Center on AI Governance ta buga kuma aka ƙaddamar a Geneva a watan Yulin 2026, ta tantance gudanarwa a ƙasashe 135 ta yin amfani da fiye da maki bayanai 68,000 da aka tattara tsakanin Nuwamba 2023 da Satumba 2025. Ta gano cewa ƙasashe 126 daga cikin 135 suna da aƙalla manufa ɗaya ta gwamnati ko shiri kan AI mai aminci, amma wannan alƙawarin ba kasafai yake zama kariya mai ƙarfin aiwatarwa ba; ƙwarewar AI tana cikin alamun da suka fi aiki da kyau, ƙasashe 71, kashi 53 cikin ɗari, suna ba da rahoton samun tsari, idan an kwatanta da ƙasashe kaɗan da ke da hukumomin sa ido masu cin gashin kansu.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: AI mai aminci, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi shi ne ginshiƙi na shida na Wits AHEAD, kuma abin da wannan ma'auni ya gano, cewa manufofin ƙwarewar AI suna gaba da hukumomin da za su iya aiwatar da su, ya ambaci ainihin gibin gudanarwa da aikin manufofin ƙungiyar ke ƙoƙarin rufe domin manyan makarantu a Kudancin Duniya.

Global Center on AI Governance · Independent global governance research index

entry.title: Preparing future STEM educators: investigating artificial intelligence literacy among pre-service STEM teachers
entry.summary:
Wani bincike da aka buga a mujallar da masana suka tantance, STEM Education, ya binciki malaman horo 541 na STEM a jihar Legas, Najeriya, mata 345 da maza 196, kan ƙwarewar su ta AI. Malaman sun ba da rahoton ƙwarewar AI mai girma gaba ɗaya, kuma ilimi da fahimtarsu game da AI sun yi hasashen yadda za su yi amfani da ita bayan haka; binciken ya kuma gano babban bambanci tsakanin jinsi a ƙwarewar AI, wanda ya fi dacewa da maza.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: AI da nazarin bayanai a cikin STEM da horar da malamai shi ne ginshiƙi na uku na Wits AHEAD, kuma wannan bambancin jinsi da aka samu a tsakanin malaman horo na jihar Legas alama ce kai tsaye ga yadda shirye-shiryen horar da malamai a Kudancin Duniya ya kamata su tsara shirin shirya kansu na AI.

STEM Education (AIMS Press) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Keeping the learning real: an integrated approach to academic integrity in the age of AI
entry.summary:
Wonkhe tare da kamfanin tantancewa Studiosity sun bincika manufofin jami'o'in Birtaniya tare da yin tattaunawa da shugabannin cibiyoyi da ɗalibai a watan Satumba 2026 kan gaskiyar ilimi a zamanin AI mai samar da abun ciki. Rahoton, da aka fitar ranar 4 ga Oktoba 2026, ya nuna cewa jami'o'i suna barin dogaro da kayan aikin gano AI, suna matsawa zuwa sake tsara tantancewa, koyar da ɗalibai yadda za su yi amfani da AI, da hanyoyin da ba na hukunci ba na tabbatar da cewa koyo ya faru. Rahoton ya ƙara da cewa tsarin gaskiyar ilimi har yanzu bai da daidaituwa kuma ɗalibai ba su amince da shi sosai ba, domin suna shakkar cewa jami'o'i za su amince da labarin da suke bayarwa kan yadda suka yi amfani da AI.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, koyarwa, tantancewa da gaskiyar ilimi, wannan bayani ne mai zurfi kuma na yanzu kan yadda babban tsarin ilimi mai zurfi yake sake tsara tantancewa maimakon ya mayar da hankali kan gano amfani da AI kawai, kuma ya bayar da tsari mai amfani na jagora ga ma'aikata da ɗalibai.

Wonkhe / Studiosity · UK higher education policy platform report, based on institutional policy review and sector roundtables

entry.title: Digital solidification: learning analytics, the panopticon, and data coloniality in South African higher education
entry.summary:
Singh, daga University of Johannesburg, ya ce nazarin bayanan koyo na iya zama kamar na'urar sa ido ta dijital wanda ke mayar da matsalolin na ɗan lokaci, kamar ɓacewar wutar lantarki ko ƙarancin bayanan waya, zuwa lakabin rashi na dindindin ga ɗalibai, a cikin tsarin mallakar bayanai ta mulkin mallaka. Rahoton bai ɗauka cewa nazarin bayanan koyo yana da illa ta zahiri ba, amma ya yi gargaɗi cewa alamun da ba a taɓa tambayarsu ko sabunta su ba suna ƙara tabarbarewar yanayin rashin daidaito na kayan more rayuwa da harshe a Afirka ta Kudu. Ya gabatar da tsari mai dogaro da adalci na zamantakewa, wanda aka gina bisa yafiya ga bayanai, binciken algorithm tare da sa hannun jama'a, da fassara alamun a cikin yanayinsu a matsayin hanyar neman taimako maimakon hukunci.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan sukar ce da masana suka tantance, kai tsaye daga Afirka ta Kudu, kan kayan nazarin hasashe da suke kan ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI da nazarin hasashe domin nasarar ɗalibai, kuma ta ba wa ginshiƙin ƙungiyar kan AI mai aminci, ɗa'a da adalci, kariya mai tushe da ya kamata a yi la'akari da su kafin ba da shawarar tsarin gargaɗi da wuri.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Helpful or harmful? Generative AI dependence, self-reported critical thinking disposition, and self-perceived employability among business students
entry.summary:
Shojaei da abokan aikinsa sun yi bincike kan ɗalibai 412 na shekarar farko ta kasuwanci a jami'o'i uku a Omaniya kan amfani da AI mai samar da abun ciki, dogaro da shi, yanayin tunani mai zurfi, da yadda suke kallon damar samun aikin yi nasu. Yawan amfani da AI ya kasance yana da alaƙa da ganin ƙarin damar samun aikin yi, amma dogaro mai yawa da AI ya kasance yana da alaƙa da raguwar tunani mai zurfi, kuma ya raunana alaƙar tabbatacciya tsakanin amfani da AI da samun aikin yi, har zuwa inda take rasa muhimmanci a lokacin da dogaro yake sosai. Marubutan sun kammala cewa amfanin yana dogara da amfani da AI ta hanyar nazari da tabbatarwa, ba yawan amfani ba, ko da yake tsarin binciken da ɗalibai suka bayar da kansu kuma a lokaci guda yana iyakance tabbacin alaƙar kai tsaye.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan yana da alaƙa da ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI, ƙwarewar ɗan'adam ta ɗaliban da suka kammala karatu da samun aikin yi, yana nuna cewa dogaro da AI ba tare da bincika shi ba na iya raunana ainihin ƙwarewar da ma'aikata suke daraja, wata gargaɗi mai alaƙa da shirye-shiryen samun aikin yi a Kudancin Duniya.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Assessment practices resistant to inappropriate AI use in Open Distance eLearning: insights from Zimbabwe Open University
entry.summary:
Magwa da Zongozzi daga University of South Africa sun yi hira da malamai, ɗalibai da jami'in tabbatar da inganci a harabar Masvingo ta Zimbabwe Open University kan irin tantancewar da take tsayayya da amfani da AI mai samar da abun ciki ba daidai ba. Sun gano cewa ayyukan aiki na zahiri, rubutun tunani, jarrabawar baki da ayyukan aji da ake kula da su sosai, su ne aka ga sun fi wahalar kammala ta hanyar yaudara da AI, ko da yake suna ƙara wa malamai nauyin aiki da matsalar yawan ɗalibai a aji. Marubutan sun yi gargaɗi cewa sakamakon da aka samu daga harabar yanki ɗaya ba za a iya ɗora shi kan dukan cibiyar ko kan koyo na nesa gaba ɗaya ba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan yana bayar da fahimtar Kudancin Duniya kan koyo na nesa wajen sake tsara tantancewa domin yaƙar amfani da AI mai samar da abun ciki ba daidai ba, don ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, kuma yana da alaƙa kai tsaye da shirye-shiryen koyo na nesa a yankin.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Automated software scoring of senior school certificate examination mathematical items in economics using a contextual similarity model
entry.summary:
Olaoye, Owolabi da Olaoye sun gwada tsarin tantance maki ta kwamfuta na tambayoyin lissafi masu amsa dogo a fannin Tattalin Arziki na makarantun sakandare mafi girma a kudu maso yammacin Najeriya, inda suka ɗauki samfurin ɗalibai 1,008 daga cikin jama'ar da ta kai kusan 275,000. Maki na shirin kwamfutar sun yi daidai sosai da na masu tantancewa goma sha biyu da aka horar, inda suka samu babban matsayi na daidaituwa (intraclass correlation) na 0.863. Marubutan sun ce gwajin ya shafi tambayoyi biyu kaɗai, kuma kowane mai tantancewa ya duba takardu 84 ne kawai, don haka ana buƙatar ƙarin tabbatarwa kafin a yi amfani da shi a jarrabawowi kamar WAEC, NECO da NABTEB.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan misali ne na amfani na ainihi, mai alaƙa da fannonin STEM, na nazarin tantancewa da aka gwada a girman jarrabawar ƙasa a Yammacin Afirka, mai alaƙa da ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI da nazari a fannonin STEM da manyan tsare-tsaren ilimi.

entry.title: Six publishers agree to feed 20 million research papers to AI agents, in a pay-per-use deal
entry.summary:
Kamfanonin buga littattafan ilimi shida, da suka haɗa da Sage, Ƙungiyar BMJ da Cibiyar Physics (Institute of Physics), sun amince da bai wa kamfani mai farawa na ƙasar Sweden, Redpine, damar ciyar da fiye da takardu miliyan 20 da masana suka tantance ga tsarin AI a cikin lokaci na ainihi, kamar yadda jaridar Times Higher Education ta ruwaito a ranar 6 ga Oktoba, 2026. Yarjejeniyar, wadda ake biyan kuɗi bisa yawan amfani, tana biyan kamfanonin buga littattafai da marubuta duk sa'ad da tsarin AI ya yi amfani da aikinsu, kuma ta shafi mujallu na likitanci, ilimin rayuwa da kimiyyar lissafi.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Dangane da ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai ɗauke da nauyi, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, yarjejeniyar ta zama gwaji na farko na yadda buga littattafan ilimi zai iya tabbatar da cewa AI na dogara da bincike mai tabbaci maimakon zato, tare da kuma warware tambayar wanda zai samu kuɗi idan na'ura, ba mai karatu ba, ce take yin ambato.

entry.title: Mystery-shopper study finds university enquiry replies 'costing enrolments', as ChatGPT outperforms
entry.summary:
Wani bincike na mai sayayya asiri da ya shafi jami'o'i 33 na Birtaniya da 30 na Ostareliya, wanda kamfanin ba da shawara Edified da kamfanin ɗaukar ma'aikata UniQuest suka gudanar, kuma jaridar Times Higher Education ta ruwaito a ranar 1 ga Oktoba, 2026, ya nuna cewa kashi 37 cikin ɗari kaɗai na tambayoyin ɗalibai masu neman shiga jami'a, wajen 700, ne suka samu amsa da ta ƙarfafa su su ci gaba da tuntuɓa. Kashi 15 cikin ɗari na tambayoyin ba su samu amsa ko ɗaya ba, kuma an ƙididdige amsoshin ChatGPT a matsayin masu sauri, cikakku, kuma masu ƙarfin yarda fiye da na jami'o'in da kansu.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Dangane da ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan nazarin bayanai da bayanai don tsarin ilimi da yanke shawara, binciken ya zama tunatarwa mai ƙarfi cewa cibiyoyin da suke tattara bayanan masu neman shiga dole su ma su yi aiki da waɗannan bayanai, domin kusan ɗalibai biyu cikin uku a cikin wannan tsokaci sun kasance ba su gamsu ba da amsar da ɗan'adam ya bayar, wanda AI mai kyau tambaya zai iya yin shi da kyau fiye da haka.

Ɗalibai sun fi amfani da waɗannan kayan aiki wajen algoriti da raya shafukan yanar gizo, kuma sun fi ƙarancin amfani da su a injiniyan software, inda galibi suke ɗauka su a matsayin mataimaka da za a bincika maimakon hukuma da za a amince da ita, suna tabbatar da sakamakon ta hanyar gwaji a cikin ayyuka masu tsari da ta hanyar bincike a yanar gizo a cikin ayyukan buɗaɗɗu.

entry.title: Copenhagen university appoints an anthropologist, not a computer scientist, to lead its AI strategy
entry.summary:
University of Copenhagen ta naɗa masanin ilimin ɗan'adam Morten Axel Pedersen a matsayin mataimakin shugaban jami'a na farko kan AI, inda ta zaɓi masanin da ya fi fahimtar yadda mutane suke aiki a zahiri maimakon masanin kimiyyar kwamfuta domin jagorantar dabarun da suka kai kroner na Denmark miliyan 110, wadda ta haɗa da ofishin AI, ƙungiyar aiki, dakunan gwaje-gwaje da mataimaki na AI mai samar da abun ciki na musamman. Pedersen, wanda a baya ya shugabanci Cibiyar Nazarin Bayanan Zamantakewa ta jami'ar, na shirin bitar kowace kwas a jami'ar cikin shekara guda domin tantance yadda za a yi amfani da AI a kowanne. Ya kwatanta muƙaminsa na shekaru uku a matsayin tsarin ɗan lokaci da za a rushe sa'ad da kowace fanni ta samu nata ƙa'idoji.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 1, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, koyarwa, tantancewa da gaskiyar ilimi, zaɓin Copenhagen yana nuna cewa yadda ɗalibai da ma'aikata suke amfani da AI a zahiri, ba abin da manufa ta ce kawai ba, shi ne mafarin da ya dace domin gyaran koyarwa da tantancewa; Wits AHEAD na ganin hakan a matsayin shaida cewa gudanar da AI a aji tambaya ta mutane ce kamar yadda take ta fasaha.

entry.title: UK research network to redo grant review after AI triage rejected half of proposals

CRANE, hanyar sadarwar bincike kan tsaron yanar gizo ta Biritaniya wacce take a University of Oxford kuma UKRI take goyon baya, ta amince ta sake yin nazarin kiran tallafinta bayan tsarin binciken farko na AI ya ƙi kusan rabin shawarwari 179 da ta samu kafin wani mai nazari ɗan'adam ya ganesu. Hanyar sadarwar ta ce ta yi amfani da tsarin kulle da amintattu maimakon kayan aikin AI na jama'a, kuma ba za a yi amfani da bayanan shawarwarin domin horar da kowane model ba; ta dakatar da tayin tallafin da aka riga aka bayar, yayin da kwamitinta ke sake nazarin kowace buƙatar da aka ƙi.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 6, AI mai ɗauke da nauyi, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, lamarin yana nuna cewa daidaita ƙofar tallafin bincike ta atomatik ba tare da bayyanawa da hanyar ƙara ba na iya kawar da aiki na gaskiya kafin wani mutum ya karanta shi; Wits AHEAD tana nuni ga sake nazarin, ba kuskuren kawai ba, a matsayin ma'aunin da ya kamata kowace cibiya mai amfani da AI wajen nazarin babban haɗari ta bi.

entry.title: Tshwane University of Technology dialogue presses South Africa to move from AI strategy to implementation
entry.summary:
Cibiyar Nazarin Makomar Aiki ta Tshwane University of Technology ta shirya Tattaunawar Makomar Aiki ta biyar a birnin Pretoria, tana haɗa gwamnati, masana da masu harkar kasuwanci a karkashin jigon ci gaba da juriya a makomar Afirka ta hanyar ƙirƙira mai ƙarfin AI. Babban darakta Tseliso Mohlomi ya ce Afirka ta Kudu dole ta koma daga dabara da muhawara zuwa aiwatarwa, yana ambaton tsaron yanar gizo, sarrafa girgije, ƙwarewar AI da injiniyan bayanai a matsayin bukatu na gaggawa na ƙwarewa. Taron ya sake maimaita shawarar da ba a aiwatar ba tun taron bara, na kafa Majalisar Ƙasa ta Aiwatar da AI domin daidaita gwamnati, jami'o'i da masu harkar kasuwanci.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 4, AI, ƙwarewar ɗalibai, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, nacin tattaunawar kan aiwatarwa maimakon ci gaba da manufofi yana da alaƙa kai tsaye da damuwar Wits AHEAD cewa takardun dabara kaɗai ba su samar da ayyukan yi ba; majalisar daidaitawa irin wadda aka gabatar ita ce tsarin da za a iya daidaita horon jami'o'i da ainihin bukatun ƙwarewa masu saurin canzawa.

entry.title: Liberia advances a national education data system to inform real-time decisions
entry.summary:
Ma'aikatar Ilimi ta Laberiya ta kammala tattaunawa ta ƙasa da masu ruwa da tsaki kan sabon manufar Education Management Information System (EMIS), wanda Tarayyar Afirka take goyon baya ta hannun Pan-African Institute for Education and Development. Mataimakin Minista Thomas Momo Parker ya ce ana buƙatar bayanai amintattu kuma na daidai lokaci domin tsara shirye-shirye, kasafin kuɗi da yanke shawara, yayin da ma'aikatar take sake farawa Ƙidayar Shekara-shekara ta Makarantu tare da gabatar da littattafan rajista na shari'a a makarantu. Tattaunawar, da aka yi a Monrovia tare da Tarayyar Turai, UNESCO, Plan International Liberia da UNICEF, ta gano gibi a gudanar da bayanai, kayan aiki, ƙwarewar fasaha da kuɗaɗe.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 5, nazarin bayanai da bayanai domin tsarin ilimi da yanke shawara, matakin Laberiya ya nuna cewa tushen bayanai na ƙasa, ba algorithm kaɗai ba, shi ne tushen da kowane tsarin Kudancin Duniya yake buƙata kafin a amince da kayan aikin hasashe ko dashboard; Wits AHEAD tana bin diddigin irin wannan tushe a matsayin sharaɗin nazarin bayanan da take bincika a sauran wurare.

entry.title: A college president on harnessing AI in education without cutting corners
entry.summary:
Shugaban Colby College, David Greene, ya shaida wa ABC News yadda wannan kwalejin liberal arts ta Amurka ke amfani da AI wajen koyarwa da koyo ta hanyar da ya bayyana a matsayin mai bin ɗa'a, ba tare da bin gajeriyar hanya ba. Wannan taƙaitaccen bayani ne kai tsaye kan jagorancin cibiya a fannin AI.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 1, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, ya nuna wani shugaban jami'a da ke ɗaukar AI a matsayin abin da za a tsara da gangan maimakon sa ido a kai kawai, matsayin da Wits AHEAD ke goyon baya a jami'o'in Afirka.

ABC News · ABC News (US national broadcaster)

entry.title: What should a university be in the age of AI? SABC News on the first Times Higher Education summit in Africa
entry.summary:
Gabanin taron Times Higher Education World Academic Summit, wanda University of Cape Town ta karɓi baƙuncinsa daga 29 ga Satumba zuwa 1 ga Oktoba, kuma shi ne na farko da aka gudanar a ƙasar Afirka, SABC News ta yi tambaya kan yadda ya kamata jami'a ta kasance yayin da AI ke sauya yadda mutane ke aiki, koyo da samar da ilimi. Mataimakin Shugaban Jami'ar UCT mai kula da Bincike da Hulɗar Ƙasa da Ƙasa, Farfesa Thokozani Majozi, ya tattauna taken taron, "Knowledge, justice and futures: Universities in the age of intelligence", da kuma rawar da jami'o'i ke takawa fiye da yaye ɗalibai.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 4, ƙwarewar waɗanda suka kammala karatu da sauyinsu zuwa rayuwar aiki, tambayar taron kan haƙƙoƙin da ke wuyan jami'o'i ga waɗanda suka kammala karatu da al'umma yayin da AI ke sauya aiki ita ce tambayar ƙungiyar kanta, wadda yanzu ake yin ta a dandalin Afirka ta Kudu.

SABC News · SABC News (public broadcaster)

entry.title: African scholarship is building a decolonial agenda for AI in university classrooms, systematic review finds
entry.summary:
Wani bita na tsari a mujallar Trends in Higher Education ya yi nazari kan bincike 25 daga 2010 zuwa 2025 kan kawar da tasirin mulkin mallaka, AI da azuzuwan jami'a a manyan makarantun Afirka. Wallafe-wallafe sun ƙaru da sauri bayan 2020 a kan jigogi uku: rashin adalci a fannin ilimi da manhaja, mulkin mallaka ta hanyar algorithm da kwasar bayanai, da kuma sauye-sauyen koyarwa da AI mai samar da abun ciki ke buƙata. Bincike ya fi yawa a Afirka ta Kudu, tare da ayyukan da ke tasowa a matakin Afirka baki ɗaya kan AI a harsunan Afirka. Marubutan sun gano cewa wani daidaitaccen shirin bincike kan kawar da mulkin mallaka a AI yana ƙara kankama, amma har yanzu shaidun bincike na zahiri kaɗan ne.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 6, AI mai alhaki da manufofi, bitar ta bayyana tambayoyin ilimin wa da harsunan wa AI ke shigarwa cikin azuzuwan Afirka, kuma ta nuna yadda tushen shaidun bincike na zahiri ke da rauni har yanzu, giɓin da bincike a Wits School of Education zai iya taimakawa wajen cike shi.

Trends in Higher Education (MDPI) · Peer-reviewed systematic review

entry.title: AI emerges as a distinct part of the student academic experience in a survey of 2,403 Bolivian undergraduates
entry.summary:
Wani bincike kan ɗaliban digiri na farko 2,403 a wata jami'a mai zaman kanta a Bolivia, wanda aka buga a Education Sciences, ya tabbatar da ingancin takardar tambayoyi mai abubuwa 31 kan yanayin karatu a jami'a, kuma ya gano cewa amfani da AI wajen koyo, kamar yadda ɗalibai suka bayyana, ya zama wani rukuni na daban tare da shiga cikin karatu, tunani mai zurfi, ingancin koyarwa da jajircewa. Amfani da AI da ɗalibai suka bayyana yana da alaƙa mai kyau da shiga cikin karatu da kuma ƙwarewar sadarwa, ɗa'a da tunani mai zurfi; marubutan sun jaddada cewa ma'aunin yana auna ra'ayoyi ne, ba sakamakon koyo ba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 1, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, ma'aunin da aka tabbatar da ingancinsa daga Kudancin Duniya, wanda ke ɗaukar amfani da AI a matsayin wani ɓangare na yadda ɗalibai ke rayuwar jami'a, kayan aiki ne mai amfani da ƙungiyar za ta iya daidaitawa don binciken ɗalibai a Afirka ta Kudu, tare da gargaɗin marubutan cewa yana auna ra'ayi ne, ba koyo ba.

Education Sciences (MDPI) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Oxford let OpenAI train AI models on Bodleian Library texts, the Guardian reports
entry.summary:
Takardun cikin gida da jaridar The Guardian ta samu sun nuna cewa Jami'ar Oxford ta bar OpenAI ta mayar da tsofaffin rubuce-rubuce na Laburaren Bodleian zuwa na'ura, da suka hada da hotuna 125,000 na kundin digirin digirgir na karni na sha tara da ashirin, da waka-waka 10,000 na titi daga zamanin Tudor, don taimakawa horar da samfuran AI nata. Haɗin gwiwar Oxford da OpenAI, da aka sanar a shekarar 2025, an gabatar da shi a matsayin aikin fadada damar samun tsofaffin takardu masu wuyar samu; ba a bayyana cewa za a yi amfani da hotunan don horar da bayanan OpenAI ba. Takardun taro na cikin gida sun nuna cewa mambobin kwamitin gudanarwa sun bayyana damuwa kan illar da za ta iya shafar daraja da kudin makamashi na AI, yayin da Oxford ta ce abubuwan sun yi kadan, ba karkashin hakkin mallaka ba, kuma za a buga su a yanar gizo cikin watanni masu zuwa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 6, AI mai ɗa'a, da'a da manufofi, wannan lamari gargaɗi ne ga kowace jami'a, a Kudancin Duniya ko a Oxford, da take ba kamfanin AI damar samun takardunta ko bayananta: idan ba a bayyana wa jama'a a sarari yadda za a yi amfani da abubuwan ba, aikin samun dama na gaskiya na iya zama, daga baya, kamar yarjejeniyar ba da bayanai a asirce, kuma shi ne gibin bayyana gaskiya da Wits AHEAD take bukatar hukumomi su rufe kafin su sa hannu.

The Guardian (Ethan Penny and Dan Milmo) · Established press investigation

entry.title: University of Ghana approves an AI policy and a compulsory digital literacy course for every student
entry.summary:
Majalisar Jami'ar Ghana ta amince da manufar AI da za ta shafi dukkan jami'ar, wadda aka tsara bayan bincike na cikin gida da ya gano gibi a horarwa, karancin damar samun kayan aikin AI, da damuwa kan daidaito, gaskiyar ilimi da da'a. A yayin sanar da wannan a bikin kammala karatu da aka yi a Accra, inda dalibai 1,884 suka kammala, mataimakin shugaban jami'ar, Farfesa Nana Aba Appiah Amfo, ta ce jami'ar za ta kuma bukaci kowane dalibi, daga shekarar karatu mai zuwa, ya dauki sabon darasi na wajibi kan ilimin dijital da AI mai amfani, tare da manufar koyarwa da koyo daban.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 1, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, yadda jami'ar gwamnati take matsawa daga takardun jagora zuwa darasin wajibi na ilimin AI ga kowane dalibin da ya kammala, wanda aka gina kan nata shaidar wuraren da dalibai da ma'aikata suke fama, shi ne irin martani mai tsari da ya shafi dukkan harabar jami'a da Wits AHEAD take nema a fadin nahiyar, maimakon manufofin da suke kawai a takarda.

University of Ghana (policy document); Ghanaian Times · University policy document

entry.title: OECD finds generative AI use nearly universal in higher education but only one in five institutions has a formal policy
entry.summary:
Rahoton OECD, Policies supporting responsible and systematic GenAI adoption in higher education, wanda aka buga a cikin jerin OECD Education Spotlights, ya gano cewa yin amfani da AI mai samar da abun ciki a tsakanin daliban jami'a ya kusan zama na kowa, yana karuwa daga kashi 66 cikin dari na daliban digiri na farko a Birtaniya a shekarar 2024 zuwa kashi 95 cikin dari a 2026, inda kashi 86 cikin dari na dalibai a binciken da aka yi a kasashe 16 suke amfani da shi. Duk da haka, kashi 19 cikin dari ne kawai na hukumomin manyan makarantu a duniya suka mallaki manufar AI mai samar da abun ciki ta hukuma a shekarar 2025, ko da yake kashi 42 cikin dari na daban suna tsara nata, kuma kashi 17 cikin dari ne kawai na ma'aikatan ilimi a duniya aka kirga a matsayin masu amfani da fasaha ko kwararru.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 6, AI mai ɗa'a, da'a da manufofi, gibin da OECD take awon, tsakanin yin amfani na yau da kullum da ya kusan zama na kowa da gudanarwa ta hukuma a jami'a daya cikin biyar, shi ne ainihin gibin da aka kafa Wits AHEAD domin taimakawa rufe shi, da tunatarwa cewa karbar kayan aikin AI da gudanar da su cikin ɗa'a ayyuka biyu ne daban-daban da mafi yawan jami'o'i ba su kammala ko daya daga cikinsu ba.

University World News (Karen MacGregor), reporting an OECD report · Intergovernmental research report, reported by established press
